title: A one-drum kit: four kick hits
description: The smallest possible percussion document: a global sound (MIDI 36, Bass Drum), a part-level kit mapping one component to a staff position, and four quarter-note events whose kitNotes reference the component instead of carrying pitched notes. Unpitched percussion is a whole MNX subsystem the renderer does not draw yet — kit events currently produce nothing, not even a badge — so the goldens pin an empty staff and this scenario is the tripwire for percussion support arriving.
